quick_skim.title: Refining GLSDC for Orbit Determination
quick_skim.abstract: This paper investigates the ambiguity of noisy short-arc angles-only orbit determination for a Molniya-orbit case study. Conventional Gauss Initial Orbit Determination followed by Gaussian Least-Squares Differential Correction is first shown to be unreliable under high-noise short-arc conditions, frequently failing to converge or converging to hyperbolic local solutions. To explore the candidate solution space, a Lambert-based initialization procedure is used over a grid of assumed ranges and angular-observation pairs, and the resulting states are refined using nonlinear least-squares optimization. The unconstrained solution set reveals multiple orbit families, including reentry elliptic, bounded elliptic, xGEO elliptic, and hyperbolic trajectories, all of which can reproduce the observed angular arc with comparable residuals. The solutions exhibit a structured range-velocity relationship, indicating that the angular measurements primarily constrain apparent line-of-sight motion rather than absolute range. Finally, physically motivated constraints are introduced to isolate Molniya-like bounded elliptic solutions. The results demonstrate that short-arc angles-only orbit determination is fundamentally non-unique without a priori information and that constraints should be interpreted as orbit-family selection tools rather than proof of uniqueness.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Tackles noisy short-arc angles-only orbit determination; a Lambert-based grid initialization plus nonlinear least squares reveals multiple orbit families reproducing observations.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对高噪声短弧仅测角轨道确定中传统高斯初轨加最小二乘微分修正易发散或收敛到双曲解的问题，作者以Molniya轨道为案例展开研究。方法上用基于兰伯特问题的初始化在假定距离与角度观测网格上生成候选解，再以非线性最小二乘精化状态。结果显示无约束解集包含再入椭圆、有界椭圆、xGEO椭圆和双曲等多族轨道，均可复现观测。该工作揭示了短弧定轨的多解模糊性，对稳健轨道确定与自主导航有参考价值。
